messages:
Sophia: Quick challenge — who's up for a 12:30 stair-sprint? 6 flights, run up and down, fastest gets coffee on me. :coffee: Who's in? @Anna @Ben
Ben: I'm in. Stretch first? :sweat_smile:
Mike: Count me in too. Bringing a stopwatch. Anybody want to make it best-of-3? :muscle:
Anna: I'll cheer from the lobby (probably on stairs by default). Can we do 12:45 instead? Meeting ran long.
FitBot: FitBot logged: 'Stair Climb' for Sophia — 6 flights, ~78 steps, est. 2m at 2024-04-22 12:35. :trophy:
Ben: Lol FitBot is already creeping on us. 12:45 works for me. Meet by the east stairs.
Mike: Perfect. Loser buys protein bars for the team? Or posts a sweaty selfie in #random? :laughing:
Sophia: Deal. May the best cardio win. :muscle:
